name: @hey-jenna/desktop
description: hey jenna studio for Mac: the studio and pinterest.com side by side

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts src/preload-studio.ts src/preload-pinterest.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:electron --outdir=dist
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @hey-jenna/web && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
